fraud.text: (xi) (a) According to the information and explanations given to us, no fraud by the Company or on the Company by its officers or employees has been noticed or reported during the course of our audit. statutory_dues.text:
(a)  The company does not have liability in respect of Service Tax, Duty of excise, Sales tax and value added tax during the year since effective 1st July 2017, these statutory dues has been subsumed in to Goods & Service Tax.
 
According to the information and explanations given to us and on the basis of our examination of the records of the Company, amounts deducted/ accrued in the books of account in respect of undisputed statutory dues including provident fund, income-tax, duty of customs, Goods and Service Tax, cess and other material statutory dues have been regularly deposited during the year by the Company with the appropriate authorities. As explained to us, the Company did not have any dues on account of employees’ state insurance.

operating_notes.text: Cash Flow from Operations for FY26 stood at Rs. 75 crs, showing significant improvement over last year
Emerging Markets business is now cash flow positive with EBITDA margin at approximately 12% for FY26
Operating cash flow for FY26 stood at around INR75 crores.
Havix Group Inc, USA planned capacity expansion of 0.8 Bn units for ₹18 Cr by March 2027.
Apnar Pharma Private Limited planned capacity expansion of 0.7 Bn units for ₹20 Cr by March 2027.
Ratnatris Pharmaceuticals added a new PFS line of 2.7 Mn units for ₹5 Cr by March 2027.
Commercialized 32 ANDAs with 54 strengths as of Q2FY27.
R&D intensity maintained at 11% of revenue in H1FY27.
IPO proceeds of ₹418.83 Cr utilized as of Sep-2026.

timeline.summary: Mr. Swapnil Jatinbhai Shah, Promoter, disclosed no new encumbrances on Senores Pharmaceuticals shares for FY2026 beyond prior disclosures.
Senores Pharmaceuticals reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹175.19 Cr and PAT of ₹36.67 Cr, and announced changes in key managerial personnel.
Senores Pharmaceuticals raised ₹95 Cr via preferential issue of convertible equity warrants on March 28, 2026
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹192.33 Cr; net profit to shareholders ₹39.49 Cr (+22.0% YoY).
On October 29, 2026, Senores Pharmaceuticals announced capacity expansions across its subsidiaries Havix Group, Apnar Pharma, and Ratnatris Pharmaceuticals for an estimated total cost of ₹43 crore.
Senores Pharmaceuticals reported a 58% jump in H1 EBITDA and maintained its strong growth outlook for the US market.
Audio recording of earnings call for Q2 & H1FY27 held on Thursday, October 29, 2026, link: https://senorespharma.com/investor-meet/

upcoming_events.description: Completion of proposed capacity expansions across subsidiaries
